text:
anna: FYI legal pushed back on our audit export/retention draft. They want a clear operator-friendly checklist that reduces PagerDuty churn. Can we define what counts as 'oncall-friendly' audit retention for enterprise launches?
devon: Yes please. Current reindexing jobs spam alerts at night. We need tenant opt-outs and adaptive throttles.
kevin: Quick clarifying Q: is the ask about fewer notifications or making it easier to triage them?
anna: Both. From product POV: reduce noise + make root-cause links immediate (one click to full event). Ops wants throttles + priority lanes. Legal wants immutability guarantees and CMEK proof.
priya: Also SOC2: we need reproducible evidence packs and KMS usage logs. Add a legal-hold snapshot API in scope.
marta: Sales chiming in: customers want per-tenant retention tiers as billable features. If we can do 1y/3y/7y add-ons, that upsell path is clean.
devon: Ops constraints: reindex/compaction should automatically backoff when tail CPU crosses threshold. Preferable: schedule heavy jobs to maintenance windows and have a quick pause API.
kevin: KMS notes: support CMEK with a handshake that records KEK fingerprints + key-rotation events. Must be able to export key-use logs for auditors. We'll include rotation test vectors.
anna: Draft launch-minimums:
```
- Structured audit events (JSON schema v1) with stable field names
- Default retention profile: compact summaries 90d, full events 30d
- Per-tenant retention profiles (UI + API) with billing tags
- Legal-hold mode + immediate exportable snapshot (immutable flag)
- CMEK/BYOK integration doc + key-use audit export
- Oncall suppression: alert aggregation window, dynamic throttle, and summary alerts with direct links
- Background job scheduler + peak-hour compaction pause API
- SOC2 evidence pack generator for 90d + KMS logs
```
priya: Add privacy controls: pseudonymization toggle for telemetry-derived logs and per-region defaults for data sovereignty (EU/EEA, APAC).
marta: For pricing, recommend a baseline (90d) included, charged add-ons for extended tiers; include a migration fee for moving cold archive off our infra.
devon: Operational acceptance criteria:
```
- Indexing jobs must not push node CPU > 60% for longer than 5m during business hours
- Tail API latency delta (95th) < 100ms during retention jobs
- PagerDuty alerts from retention jobs <= 1/week during pilot
```
kevin: Technical acceptance for KMS:
```
- Successful handshake tests with sample customer KEK
- Rotation workflow validated end-to-end (customer rotates KEK, we re-encrypt DEKs, no downtime)
- Exportable key-use logs in auditor-friendly CSV/JSON
```
anna: Rollout plan: pilot with 2-3 enterprise customers -> invite-only beta -> GA after SLOs and legal signoff. Pilot must include at least one EU tenant for data-sovereignty test.
priya: Legal wants a runbook for legal-hold + removal process and a clear statement on immutability guarantees (what we can promise vs what requires customer escrow).
devon: Implementation notes for eng-sre: implement a suppression controller that aggregates similar alerts, creates a summary every X minutes, and links to the first/last full event. Add tenant-level alerting knobs.
kevin: I'll write KMS acceptance tests and add an escrow fallback note (what we store vs customer responsibility).
anna: Owners: Anna -> product checklist and pilot plan; Devon -> suppression/ops design; Kevin -> KMS + tests; Priya -> legal/SOC2 mapping and runbook.
ops-bot: Reminder: compliance sync Tue 10:00.
anna: Target: have customer-facing checklist + pilot pricing by next Wed EOD. Anyone blocked?
marta: Will confirm initial pilot customers by EOD tomorrow.
kevin: No blockers from infra side, will post test plan by EOD today.
devon: Will start a short design doc in #eng-sre and link here.
anna: Thanks all. Let's keep the checklist tight — legal/sales/ops signoff before beta. :thumbsup:
